categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in environmental remediation services, including soil and groundwater remediation, water environment restoration, mining ecological restoration, landfill site management, and high-standard farmland construction. It also provides technical consulting and operational services related to environmental restoration and is expanding into solid waste resource utilization and hazardous waste safe disposal. The business covers the entire environmental remediation industry chain from consulting, design, treatment, operation to management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced remediation technologies such as chemical oxidation/reduction, thermal desorption, in-situ thermal desorption, soil washing, solidification/stabilization, gas extraction, and deep soil mixing. It has developed proprietary equipment and integrated multi-technology systems, including factory-mode remediation and intelligent monitoring platforms. The company also focuses on green and low-carbon remediation technologies, leveraging AI, IoT, and digital platforms for precise and sustainable environmental management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and industrial clients requiring environmental remediation for contaminated sites, mining areas, farmland, and landfills. The company serves markets related to industrial pollution control, agricultural soil improvement, mining ecological restoration, and urban environmental governance. Major projects involve large-scale contaminated site remediation and ecological restoration driven by national environmental policies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant business in North China, East China, South China, and other regions. It has established subsidiaries and project bases in multiple provinces including Beijing, Tianjin, Liaoning, Jiangsu, Anhui, Yunnan, and Shandong. The geographic coverage aligns with key industrial and ecological zones requiring environmental remediation services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental remediation supply chain, providing comprehensive remediation solutions, technical consulting, project implementation, and post-remediation risk management. It also extends into upstream resource utilization by developing technologies and equipment for solid waste treatment and hazardous waste disposal, integrating resource recovery with remediation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing green and low-carbon remediation technologies, expanding multi-dimensional remediation services, and integrating AI and digital technologies for smart environmental management. The company invests heavily in R&D through national engineering laboratories and partnerships with top research institutions, focusing on microbial remediation, in-situ chemical oxidation, thermal desorption, and resource recycling technologies. It also pursues new business models such as ecological environment-oriented development (EOD) and integrated remediation plus industrial development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based sales of environmental remediation solutions under EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) contracts, technical consulting fees, and operational management services. The company also earns income from sales of remediation products and equipment. Revenue recognition is based on contract progress and milestone payments, with a focus on long-term contracts and risk management services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic environmental remediation service provider in China, recognized as a top player in soil remediation projects and awarded multiple industry honors. It holds a dominant market position with extensive experience in large-scale and complex remediation projects. Competitors include other specialized remediation firms, state-owned enterprises, and emerging private companies in the environmental protection sector. The company leverages its technological leadership, comprehensive service offerings, and strong project execution capabilities to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 796.5 million RMB, a 36.1% decrease from 2023, mainly due to macroeconomic and policy factors slowing industry investment. Net profit declined significantly, impacted by increased credit impairment provisions on long-aged receivables. Despite revenue contraction, the company improved operating cash flow by 58.33% year-over-year and is actively expanding new business segments such as solid waste resource utilization and high-standard farmland construction. The company has total assets nearing 3 billion RMB and equity of about 1.3 billion RMB, reflecting a mid-sized enterprise with stable but challenged growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, full-industry-chain environmental remediation solutions combining advanced proprietary technologies, integrated multi-technology approaches, and intelligent digital management platforms. It differentiates through its ability to handle large-scale, complex, and rare contamination cases with high-quality project execution and risk control. The company’s strategic focus on green, low-carbon, and sustainable remediation technologies, along with innovative business models like EOD, positions it as a pioneer in transforming environmental remediation into ecological and industrial integrated development.
